role: name of the unary sentence exists x U(x)
notes: Spencer's sentence name (section 1 p. 1); a sentence constant not a predicate.

role: t-closure of a vertex set X in a graph (least t-closed superset)
notes: Spencer's italic cl_t (section 4 p. 8); the same notion is written \(\mathrm{cl}_t(X)\) in sec:p03-w03-p03-067-constant-p; t=0 gives X itself.

role: isomorphism of t-closures sending each x_i to x_i'
notes: Spencer's notation (pp. 8-9); with a graph H on the right it means isomorphism with the roots in specified positions.

role: rooted graph (X with the induced subgraph on X union Y)
notes: Editorial abbreviation; not in the source.

role: number of edges of G with an end in Y minus S and the other end in X union Y (possibly infinite)
notes: Editorial; the e parameter of the rooted graph (S;G restricted to X union Y). Distinct from e_A in the P3 40.2 intake.

role: least value of (e alpha - v)/v over 1<=v<=t and e with v - e alpha < 0
notes: Spencer's epsilon in the Finite Closure Lemma (p. 9); local to that lemma and its proof.

role: t-round Ehrenfeucht game on graphs (or structures) G and H
notes: Spencer writes both EHR[G;H;t] (section 14 p. 26) and EHR(M1;M2;t) (p. 3); the parenthesized form is registered in the P3 40.4 intake for the same game.

role: first-order properties: every two distinct vertices joined by a path of length three (P_3) or by a walk x1~y1~y2~x2 (P_3^w)
notes: Editorial names for Spencer's example (section 2 p. 5).

role: first-order formula expressing cl_t(x)~=H with roots in place
notes: Editorial name.

role: real number \(|V(H)\setminus S|-\alpha e_H(S)\) for a finite graph H and S a subset of V(H)
notes: Editorial function notation for Spencer's v - e alpha (section 3 p. 6 and section 5); f(V(H)H)=0.

role: number of edges of H with at least one end outside S
notes: Editorial; the e parameter of the nailextension (S;H).

role: first-order theory (graph axioms plus Nonexistence and Generic Extension schemas) for p = n^-alpha
notes: Spencer writes T = T_alpha (section 5 p. 9); depends on the irrational alpha.

role: number of (R;H) extensions over the root tuple x counted as ordered tuples
notes: Spencer's N(x) (section 5 p. 10); N_J(x) is the same count for a rooted graph (R;J).

role: expected number of (R;H) extensions over a fixed root tuple
notes: Spencer's mu (section 5 p. 10); local to the section.

role: max of 0 and the greatest f(S;J) over R <= S < V(J)
notes: Editorial; local to the moment lemma and its uses.

role: least f(R;H|_S) over R < S <= V(H) for a safe rooted graph
notes: Editorial; positive exactly by safety.

role: the epsilon of the Finite Closure Lemma for parameter t
notes: Indexed form of Spencer's epsilon (p. 9).

role: closure parameters of Duplicator's strategy in EHR[G;G';u]
notes: Spencer's t_0...t_u (section 5 p. 11); here chosen by an explicit formula.

role: names in Duplicator's step: BIG=t_i; SMALL=t_{i-1}; OLD=cl_BIG(x); NEW=vertices of cl_SMALL(x;y) outside OLD
notes: Spencer's names (section 5 pp. 11-12).

role: maximum density of a finite graph H (largest edges-per-vertex ratio of a subgraph)
notes: Editorial notation for the containment threshold; not in Spencer's text.

role: first-order sentence saying that a copy of the graph H exists
notes: Editorial name; Spencer speaks of the existence of a copy of H (p. 15).

role: graph of maximum density b/a (power of a cycle with chords)
notes: Editorial construction; Spencer asserts only that some such H exists (p. 15).

role: first-order formula: the tuple x is coded by a block of k+1 consecutive vertices in [c d) of the ordered graph
notes: Editorial; realizes Spencer's remark on k-ary relations (p. 23).

role: largest u for which every k-ary relation on {1..u} is almost surely represented
notes: Editorial bound floor((log_2 n/(2k+2))^(1/(k+1))).

role: constant in the influence bound for narrow depth-d circuits
notes: Editorial constants c_2=2 and c_d=32(2^(d-2)c_(d-1)+1).

role: constant in Boppana's total-influence bound
notes: Editorial constant K_d=3^(d-1)c_(d+1); O.Donnell writes O(log s)^(d-1) (thm. 4.30 p. 106).

role: positive exponent in the stretched-exponential deviation bound exp[-n^lambda]
notes: Spencer's lambda (p. 10); local to the corollary. Section 40.7 uses lambda for an exponent parameter; different scope.
